hypothesis: Train the actual native reference HybridPilot from numeric selected-action consequences, find its feasible resource/learning ceiling at the largest measurable configuration, then remove model capacity and mechanisms to determine minimal structure preserving causal prediction, retention, OOD transfer, compute efficiency.
null: If complete sufficient training fails stronger fully trained GRU/MLP controls and cold-return/OOD, no causal-learning advantage shown; OOM or too-small budget is incomplete feasibility, not scientific NO_GO.

capacity.components: Existing model.HybridPilot: selective recurrent state, causal attention, TTTLinearMemory read-before-write, threshold CausalDepthRouter. Reference CPU only, NOT official Mamba2/TTT CUDA.
capacity.test: Fresh isolated subprocess full real reference forward/backward/AdamW step, numeric continuous inputs, measured wall time / peak RSS / params and constraints. Timeout/OOM/other failure recorded faithfully.
capacity.success_definition: Largest actually PASS measured width x length on current CPU. All unprobed larger tiers remain UNVERIFIED. NOT model learning capacity or GPU capability.

learning.tokenless_inputs: 13 continuous features: 4 onehot current selected action, 4 onehot previous selected action, 4 previous selected outcome, public time/40. Labels are CURRENT actual selected reward only, never included in current input.
learning.causal_worlds: Fresh balanced stable/A-B-A laws and actuator alignment; action CALIBRATE0 physically sets alignment and incurs cost, chosen exploit +/- selected rewards depend on alignment and private sign; original R70 physical rule with independent numeric selected outcomes. OOD has shifted switch timing and causal reward/noise parameters.
learning.full_training_requirement: Attempt maximum feasible width cumulative 65536 updates with checkpoint resume and frozen fit-validation stop; only then work backward on width, TTT/SSM/attention/depth. Never assert true capacity ceiling from a few updates.
learning.saturation: At least 16384 optimizer updates AND less than 1% relative improvement in FIT validation for two consecutive 4096-step windows before saturation claim.
learning.compare: Fully trained conventional GRU/MLP with matched FIT selected exposure and objective, report params/wall/FLOPs separately; old fixed policy and shuffled-history negative.
learning.admission: Both seeds gain >=5% DEV MSE, >=5% cold return and OOD MSE over strongest fully trained conventional control, paired bootstrap; incomplete budgets = INCOMPLETE not NO_GO.
learning.data_custody: Do not generate DEV/OOD until all model/ablation/control weights frozen. No prior R64-R73 scored data, no private signs or future outcome features. Freeze thresholds before scoring; never tune on DEV/OOD.
learning.claim: Even PASS means reference model DEV mechanism only, not full official Mamba2/TTT/GPU native agent, action selection or general intelligence.
